rationale: David brings a decade of production robotics experience (drones, tractors, autonomous systems) and deep conviction that real-time infrastructure is foundational to shipping robotics at scale—exactly the infrastructure and ML observability gaps he's now building at LiveKit. intro_message: David Chen, meet Kaarel Kaarelson — you both ship robotics and ML infrastructure fast, and David's convictions on real-time comms for production autonomous systems could be directly relevant as Kaarel scales matching problems at Known.com.
